verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents porting business numbers in and choosing an activation date when submitting a port. Nothing in the evidence shows a port status view, an expected completion date reported back to the admin, or rejection reasons for a failed port. A user-chosen activation date is a request input, not status tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, a port shows its status and expected completion date, and a rejected port says why
